evidence:
No concrete ambiguity or unreachable public capability was found for quality row 6. This is a scoped achievability finding, not task clearance. The workbook Quality Checks!A7:D7 allows the supplied runtime and public internet; the older no-network wording in Internal Quality Checks!D7 is superseded by the actual task public network and the frozen skill delivery profile. Frozen task instruction.md:7-13 states the notes, Node/Express/SQLite launch, port, health check, DB_PATH, asset copying, optional operational history and complete credentials. environment/Dockerfile:1-16 supplies Node 22, express 5.1.0, better-sqlite3 12.4.1, instructions and seed; these match the frozen template. integration.md:3-18 and hireops_rules.md:415-420 describe the separate working-directory/unprivileged runtime. 

The public rules resolve the plausible competing readings: hireops_rules.md:59-87 distinguishes the fixed referral clock from rescission dates and gives exact integer/rounding limits; :111-145 separates intrinsic/annualized equity, run-rate, amortized signing and excluded relocation; :154-172 defines inclusive higher-tier authority and exact band edges; :229-279 fixes revision lineage, payment differences, vesting anchors and rescission; :292-305 specifies original-anchor calendar clamping, valid date formats and milliseconds; :337-353 fixes future-start immediate referral credit and its independent cliff. Users, referring employees, clock and constants are present in environment/assets/seed_data.json. These operations need no outside backend or unavailable package. 

For the central contract, hireops_rules.md:424-479 states the 2-4 member shape, actor-owned key, order-insensitive immutable intent, complete netted headroom, no reservation during preview, intervening-history detection, atomic member effects and cached original receipt before later-state revalidation. The implementation is a constructive feasible route: solution/app/src/change-sets.js:38-64 nets the entire set; :77-91 durably saves canonical previews; :94-140 uses an immediate SQLite transaction and returns the saved committed row before checking fresh leaves. rules.js:24-70 uses explicit calendar validation and BigInt final rounding. Readable UI and retained-input requirements are directly reachable in the hash-bound local/batch-ui.cjs:25-55 observations, including a genuinely forwarded successful commit whose browser response is then aborted, same-operation retry, and a separate Auditor context. 

Adversarial broken-app reading: sequential per-member budget checks seem superficially reasonable but reject the fully funded exchange. They are explicitly excluded by hireops_rules.md:444-447 and functional/prompt.md:59. The local/batch-witnesses.cjs sequential_budget mutation returned 409 instead of 200 on that concrete cycle; the balance_only_version mutant accepted a stale restored-balance preview (200 instead of 409), and no_cached_receipt revalidation rejected a retry (409 instead of 200). These are finite scripted observations, not measured rubric scores. 

Conforming alternative: omit all optional operational seed rows and use generated IDs, different routes and layouts. instruction.md:11, hireops_rules.md:91-95/203-204/436 and functional/prompt.md:13/23/49/57 explicitly permit those choices; the empty_operational_seed witness completed all 15 transaction groups. The prompt also acknowledges the single Finance account and forbids inventing a second account/API (functional/prompt.md:67). Thus those alternatives do not create an instruction-derived false failure in the inspected protocols. 

Hash/evidence verification: raw-evidence-index.json SHA256 81d7e30b67ececf39d5d2351a9f41140a8e5e401174e6a80efe9b9d7503791f1 identifies the assigned input; all 239 indexed artifact hashes matched current bytes. I separately compared every embedded source hash in archive-batch-domain (4), targeted-golden (14), install-lifecycle (13), legacy-ui (13) and batch-ui (14) results against the frozen task, with no mismatches. Relevant raw result hashes: local/batch-witnesses/results.json 477ba650c81ce00e5d6346f679b774f23c5a197b78b346bb183e7eb0a70bcf83; local/archive-batch-domain/results.json a44c0bf81b27981d9bf1d63239f8b7ce7da5733d6d70aef425e2350a76b7732f; local/install-lifecycle/results.json 125aa681a04307790302ad83f62dec1db084392d8dee6519346cb57c31ed8dee.
